scenes.narration: Moving your app to GPT-6.2? Check these before you switch.
scenes.visual_description: Bold title card with a simple arrow from an 'Old model' box to a 'GPT-6.2' box and a checklist icon. Plain shapes, no logos.

scenes.narration: OpenAI says GPT-6.2 Astra is for demanding reasoning and coding tasks,
scenes.visual_description: Left card labelled 'Astra' with the OpenAI-attributed use case as text. Caption 'OpenAI says' above. No logos.

scenes.narration: and GPT-6.2 Sol is for everyday coding and agent workflows. That's positioning, not a ranking.
scenes.visual_description: Right card 'Sol' slides in beside Astra card; a 'not a ranking' tag appears between them with no better/worse markers.

scenes.narration: Now, three checks from OpenAI's changelog. First, OpenAI says tool calling requires the Responses API.
scenes.on_screen_text: Check 1: Tool calling needs Responses API
scenes.visual_description: Numbered checklist card with item 1 highlighted; a flow arrow from 'Tool calls' to a 'Responses API' box. Small caption 'Source: OpenAI changelog, Nov 17'.

scenes.narration: Both models also support Chat Completions, but anything that calls tools needs Responses.
scenes.visual_description: Two lanes: 'Chat Completions' lane supported; 'Tool calling' arrow routes only into the 'Responses API' lane.

scenes.narration: Second, OpenAI says GPT-6.2 changes how the Responses API preserves reasoning when you edit a conversation's prefix.
scenes.visual_description: Diagram of a message list with the first messages highlighted as 'prefix' and a pencil marker; a 'reasoning' bubble beside it with a question mark (behavior changed).

scenes.narration: If your app rewrites earlier messages, test that. Third, it changes how the top-level instructions field is handled.
scenes.visual_description: Checklist card: item 2 gets a 'test it' tick, then item 3 highlights a field labelled 'instructions' at the top of a request diagram.

scenes.narration: OpenAI points to a GPT-6.2 migration guide for recommended integration updates. Worth reading before you ship.
scenes.visual_description: Simple document card titled 'GPT-6.2 migration guide' with a 'worth reading' tag; no copied page content.

scenes.narration: Which of these checks matters most for your app? Tell me below.
scenes.visual_description: Recap card with the three checks as a numbered list and a comment-prompt bubble.
